mapper.sql: id, movie_id, year, month, day, weekday
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS total_movies, AVG(m.score) AS avg_score FROM movies m INNER JOIN release_dates rd ON m.id = rd.movie_id WHERE rd.year = #{year} AND rd.month = #{month} GROUP BY rd.year, rd.month

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS total_movies, AVG(m.score) AS avg_score FROM movies m INNER JOIN release_dates rd ON m.id = rd.movie_id WHERE rd.year = #{year} AND CASE WHEN #{quarter} = 1 THEN rd.month BETWEEN 1 AND 3 WHEN #{quarter} = 2 THEN rd.month BETWEEN 4 AND 6 WHEN #{quarter} = 3 THEN rd.month BETWEEN 7 AND 9 WHEN #{quarter} = 4 THEN rd.month BETWEEN 10 AND 12 END GROUP BY rd.year

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS total_movies, AVG(m.score) AS avg_score, CASE rd.weekday WHEN 0 THEN '周一' WHEN 1 THEN '周二' WHEN 2 THEN '周三' WHEN 3 THEN '周四' WHEN 4 THEN '周五' WHEN 5 THEN '周六' WHEN 6 THEN '周日' END AS weekday_name FROM movies m INNER JOIN release_dates rd ON m.id = rd.movie_id WHERE rd.weekday = #{weekday} GROUP BY rd.weekday

SELECT rd.year AS release_year, COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS total_movies, AVG(m.score) AS avg_score FROM movies m INNER JOIN release_dates rd ON m.id = rd.movie_id WHERE rd.year = #{year} GROUP BY rd.year
